```{r}
path <- "."

csv_files <- list.files(
  path = path,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

for (file in csv_files) {
  obj_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
  assign(obj_name, read.csv(file), envir = .GlobalEnv)
}
```

```{r}

```


```{r}
merged_video_features <- video_summary_all %>%
  rename(visual_density_1 = mean_visual_density) %>%
  left_join(

    by = "video_name"
```

```{r}
all_data <- bind_rows(
  all_dat_cat,
  all_dat_sensor,
  all_dat_voe,
  all_dat_cat_2,
  all_dat_sensor_2,
  all_dat_voe_2
)
```

```{r}
all_data$Video <- sub("^video/", "", all_data$Video)
```

```{r}
all_data_merged <- all_data %>%
  left_join(merged_video_features, by = c("Video" = "video_name"))
```

```{r}
write.csv(all_data_merged, "all_data_merged.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

# =========================
# 1. 数据预处理
# =========================
dat_model <- all_data_merged %>%
  mutate(
    Subject   = factor(Subject),
    Video     = factor(Video),
    condition = factor(condition),
    ACC       = as.integer(ACC),

    # 视觉复杂度：这里先用 visual_density_1
    Visual_Z   = as.numeric(scale(visual_density_1)),

    # physical_z 虽然名字里已有 z，这里再标准化一次也可以
    Physical_Z = as.numeric(scale(physical_z))
  )

# 看一下 condition 的水平
levels(dat_model$condition)
```

```{r}
all_dat_merged <- dat_model %>% select(Video, Subject, condition, RT_onset, RT_critical, ACC, Visual_Z, Physical_Z)
write.csv(all_dat_merged, "all_dat_merged.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
```

```{r}

# =========================
# 2. RT模型：只用正确试次
#    因变量 = log(RT_critical)
# =========================
dat_rt <- dat_model %>%
  filter(
    ACC == 1,
    !is.na(RT_critical),
    RT_critical > 0,
    !is.na(Visual_Z),
    !is.na(Physical_Z)
  )

m_rt <- lmer(
  log(RT_critical) ~ condition * Visual_Z + condition * Physical_Z +
    (1 | Subject) + (1 | Video),
  data = dat_rt,
  REML = FALSE
)

summary(m_rt)
anova(m_rt)

```

```{r}

# =========================
# 3. ACC模型：用全部试次
#    因变量 = ACC (0/1)
# =========================
dat_acc <- dat_model %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ACC),
    !is.na(Visual_Z),
    !is.na(Physical_Z)
  )

m_acc <- glmer(
  ACC ~ condition * Visual_Z + condition * Physical_Z +
    (1 | Subject) + (1 | Video),
  data = dat_acc,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)

summary(m_acc)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 4. 导出模型摘要
# =========================
sink("../lmm/model_summary.txt")
cat("===== RT model =====\n")
print(summary(m_rt))
cat("\n\n===== RT ANOVA =====\n")
print(anova(m_rt))

cat("\n\n===== ACC model =====\n")
print(summary(m_acc))
sink()
```

```{r}
library(emmeans)
acc_phys_slopes <- emtrends(
  m_acc,
  specs = "condition",
  var = "Physical_Z"
)

summary(acc_phys_slopes, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
pairs(acc_phys_slopes)
```

```{r}
acc_visual_slopes <- emtrends(
  m_acc,
  specs = "condition",
  var = "Visual_Z"
)

summary(acc_visual_slopes, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
pairs(acc_visual_slopes)
```
